subject: Batch PO issuance — TwinPeak onboarding: reconcile spend buckets & line-item mapping
messages:
From: Sarah Ortega <sarah.ortega@twinpeak.io>

Cc: procurement@twinpeak.io
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 14:20:00 -0400
Subject: TwinPeak onboarding forms + requested PO numbers

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood's onboarding checklist this week. I've attached the completed onboarding form and the SKU allocation CSV (the file includes the regional breakdown and the initial monthly estimates). A couple of quick notes we noticed while filling the spreadsheet:

- One of our SKUs (TP-DB-XL) is currently listed as a single line item but should be split across ingest costs (TP-DB-XL-ING) and compute-hours (TP-DB-XL-COMP).
- The procurement team has a hard $50k monthly cap per PO for new vendors; we can split across multiple PO numbers if needed.

We need Redwood to:
1) confirm the correct line-item mapping (so our SOW lines up with billing),
2) issue the PO number(s) and confirm spend cap(s) per PO, and
3) return a signed stub/PO so we can complete our vendor setup.

Attached: TwinPeak_Onboarding_Form.pdf, TP_SKU_Allocation_Q2.csv

Happy to hop on a short call if helpful — but a reply with PO numbers and any proposed line-item corrections would be perfect.

Best,
Sarah Ortega
Head of Procurement, TwinPeak Systems

Priyom, please review the SKU split suggestion below and confirm GL mapping.

Thanks — aiming to reply to TwinPeak by EOD Monday (7/6).

Thanks for the ping. Quick read-through and notes:

- We do not have an active supplier token for TwinPeak; this will be a provisional onboarding. Procurement system will require PO stubs to finish the vendor record.
- Given TwinPeak's stated $50k monthly cap per PO, we should split into two POs to keep the primary platform spend under the cap and isolate the storage/backup SKU to a second PO. Proposed split:
  * PO-A: Platform + Compute (up to $45k/month)
  * PO-B: Storage/Backup + Data Transfer (up to $15k/month) — keeps us conservative in case of surge.
- SKU mapping: TP-DB-XL -> TP-DB-XL-ING (ingest) should map to GL: 4102, TP-DB-XL-COMP (compute) map to GL: 4207.

Attachments: I've drafted a PO matrix stub (Redwood_PO_Matrix_Template.xlsx) with the proposed line splits and spend caps — Laura, can you reserve 2 PO numbers and add a short note on provisional flags?

Ben Carter
Vendor Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: TwinPeak onboarding — assigned PO numbers, spend caps & line-item corrections

Hi Sarah / TwinPeak team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the onboarding form. Per internal review we've split your initial allocation into two provisional PO numbers to align with your $50k cap and to keep line-item granularity clean for billing:

- PO-2026-7782: Platform + Compute
  * Monthly cap: $45,000
  * Lines: TP-DB-XL-COMP (GL 4207), TP-PLF-BASE (GL 4101)

- PO-2026-7783: Storage + Transfer
  * Monthly cap: $15,000
  * Lines: TP-DB-XL-ING (GL 4102), TP-ARCHIVE (GL 4305)

What we changed from your CSV: TP-DB-XL was split into TP-DB-XL-ING (ingest) and TP-DB-XL-COMP (compute) to match our billing categories. We've attached the updated PO stub and the PO matrix for your records. These POs are marked provisional in our system pending vendor verification (KYC) and a signed acknowledgment from TwinPeak.

Next steps / mutual action plan:
1) Sarah: review the attached PO stubs and confirm the SKU-to-line mapping is acceptable to your finance team (reply to this thread).
2) TwinPeak: return signed PO stubs to procurement@redwood.com so we can finalize vendor token and remove provisional flags.
3) Redwood: once signed stubs received, Laura will finalize PO activation and notify Finance for budget coding.

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Matrix_Template.xlsx, TwinPeak_PO_Stub_PO-2026-7782.pdf, TwinPeak_PO_Stub_PO-2026-7783.pdf

If you prefer a 20-minute call to walk the matrix, I'm available this afternoon. Otherwise, please reply with the signed stub.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
